description: Hydropower Data for Global Risk Pooling Can Mitigate Drought-Related Financial Risk for Hydropower-Dependent Countries is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rosa Isabella Cuppari (University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill). Hydropower-related data used in Cuppari et al. Global Risk Pooling Can Mitigate Drought-Related Financial Risk for Hydropower-Dependent Countries. Data from the US EIA, IRENA, and the World Bank does not otherwise have a DOI. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
